headline: Bitcoin's worst ETF month on record: $4.5B in June outflows cap a 20% crash
summary: June ended badly for Bitcoin — the asset fell 20% over the month, and U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs shed $4.5 billion, their worst monthly outflow on record. On the final day of the month, Bitcoin slipped another 0.68% to $58,873, with most of the top 15 assets following it lower. Solana was the notable exception, rising 2.16%. The Fear & Greed index sits at 11 — deep in Extreme Fear territory — and Stellar surged 11% on the day, though no clear catalyst has been identified for that move.

winners.name: WhiteBIT Coin
winners.catalyst: WhiteBIT Coin surged 14.08% as buying interest concentrated in the asset despite the broader market decline, with no single identified external catalyst.

losers.name: LAB
losers.catalyst: LAB dropped 31.11% amid negative sentiment following reports of record Bitcoin ETF outflows in June, which weighed heavily on smaller, higher-risk assets.

whyItMoved:
The dominant story today — and for all of June — is Bitcoin ETF outflows. U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs shed $4.5 billion in June, the worst monthly figure since those products launched. That sustained institutional selling pressure drove Bitcoin's 20% monthly decline, and the final day of the month added another 0.68% loss, closing at $58,873. Most of the top 15 tracked assets followed Bitcoin lower, with BNB (-0.74%), Dogecoin (-1.75%), and Hyperliquid (-1.77%) all posting modest declines.

Chart analysts have flagged the structure of Bitcoin's June decline as technically severe — the monthly candle's shape and the depth of the move have drawn attention, though the researcher's data does not specify a named indicator or a precise technical level that would define the next directional signal.

Solana was the clearest exception among large-cap assets, rising 2.16% to $75.28. No catalyst was identified in the researcher's data for this move.

XRP held above $1, ending the day up 0.22% at $1.045. The researcher notes that network activity on XRP improved following a leverage flush — meaning a wave of forced liquidations cleared out overleveraged positions — which left the asset on steadier footing than the broader market.

Stellar (XLM) surged 11.02% to $0.1987, the largest single-day move among the top 15. No catalyst was identified in the researcher's data.

The Fear & Greed index reading of 11 places the market firmly in Extreme Fear territory — the lowest end of the scale — reflecting how deeply the June selloff has weighed on sentiment.
worthKnowing: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded their worst month ever in June, shedding $4.5 billion in outflows — a figure that dwarfs previous monthly redemption records.
XRP held above $1 after a leverage flush cleared out overleveraged positions, with on-chain network activity improving in the aftermath.
Taiwan passed a key crypto law that removes legal uncertainty for the digital asset sector, potentially opening the market to clearer institutional participation.
WhiteBIT Coin (WBT) surged 14.08% to lead all assets on the day, while LAB fell 31.11% — the widest single-day spread in the tracked universe.
